items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I think he was in Celestan's band at one time.

ctx.x: Yeah, well they were brothers, so they might have the same name. Doesn't always happen. You know, but now you were talking about Kill D. Yes. What kind of trumpet player was he? How did he play?
Kill D was a hell of a trumpet player and a ranger. He was from out of Joe Robichaud's band also. I think he was in Celestan's band at one time.
Oh yeah. So he could get off?
